title: FINAL-OPERATIONAL-HANDOFF-BOOTSTRAP-ACCEPTANCE
rationale: Before the product final gate opens, the project must prove the complete development/workforce system can be reconstructed from the repository and handoff archive without chat history. Acceptance covers project-wide bootstrap, full Workforce bootstrap, all 19 role contracts, representative role-specific fresh-session boots, handoff-only recovery, archive validation PASS, cold recovery PASS, current findings, next authorized task, Authority precedence, Human remote boundary, Security reassessment rules, Legacy revalidation rules, and fail-closed behavior on stale/mismatched state. This gate must precede the Human Final Product Gate.
